newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sub Nigel to increase share capital.
newsitem.headline: Sub Nigel to increase share capital.

text.p: Sub Nigel Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had received shareholder approval to increase the company's authorised share capital by creating 70 million convertible preference shares of one cent each.

It said it had also been given the nod to convert the 70 million preference shares into 70 million ordinary shares of no par value so that the authorised share capital of Sub Nigel now comprises 100 million ordinary shares of no par value.
The authorised but unissued share capital of the company would remain under the directors' control until the next annual general meeting.
Sub Nigel said it anticipated making a further announcement relating to the proposed clawback offer and acquisitions referred to in an announcement dated May 12.
In the interim, it advised shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings.
